source_operation.description: Returns the status of the specified federation without the response body.

404.description: The OIDC federation has not been found.

500.description: Server is not responding. Please try again later.

request.identity: exact scoped ResourceRef; nested resource parent required; no name adoption
request.optional_fields: nil omitted; false/empty retained; explicit nullable fields distinguish null/value/absent
request.body: all source schema properties; protected material only revealed for transport
request.validation: Account view; scoped kind/endpoint/generation/parent; documented OIDC required fields, string/pattern/session bounds; group mappings max100 and ID bounds; certificate name/data required; optional null accepted only for declared OIDC fields

response.field_mapping: all declared properties with precise integers; server refs discarded
response.resource_ref: create requires nonempty ID; account/federation/ID checked against scope and parent; accepted ID retained on malformed response

retry: bounded safe read; mutations single attempt, no replay

recovery.availability: exact observation only; no adoption or inferred authorship
